requirements.statement: A Client can sign in securely so their food log and goals are private to them

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is directed to sign in before reaching the Client's log or goals
A signed-in Client sees only their own food log and goal data

requirements.statement: A Client can manually log a food entry with its name, calories, protein, carbs and fat

criteria.must: A Client can submit a food entry with name, calories, protein, carbs and fat
A submitted food entry appears in the Client's log afterward

requirements.statement: A Client can edit or delete a food entry they logged

criteria.must: A Client can edit the values of a food entry they previously logged
A Client can delete a food entry they previously logged
A deleted food entry no longer appears in the Client's log

requirements.statement: A Client can see their food entries grouped by day

criteria.must: The Client can view all food entries logged on a specific date

requirements.statement: A Client can set a daily calorie and macro (protein/carbs/fat) goal

criteria.must: A Client can set a daily goal specifying calories, protein, carbs and fat

requirements.statement: A Client can update their daily goal at any time

criteria.must: A Client can change a previously set daily goal to new values
The updated goal applies going forward until changed again

requirements.statement: A Client can see today's progress — consumed vs. goal and remaining — for calories and each macro

criteria.must: The Client's today view shows total calories, protein, carbs and fat consumed so far
The Client's today view shows the remaining amount of calories and each macro against their goal

requirements.statement: A Client can view their logging history over past days

criteria.must: The Client can view a history of past days with their logged totals

requirements.statement: A Client can grant a Coach access to their log and goal progress

criteria.must: A Client can grant access to a Coach by entering the Coach's email address
After being granted access, the Coach can see that Client in their client list

requirements.statement: A Client can revoke a Coach's access

criteria.must: A Client can revoke a previously granted Coach's access
After revocation, the Coach can no longer view that Client's data

requirements.statement: A Coach can sign in securely and access only the Clients who granted them access

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is directed to sign in before reaching any Coach view
A signed-in Coach cannot view a Client's data unless that Client granted them access

requirements.statement: A Coach can see the list of Clients who have granted them access

criteria.must: The Coach sees a list containing every Client who granted them access

requirements.statement: A Coach can view a Client's daily log and goal progress read-only, without changing it

criteria.must: The Coach can open a granting Client's daily log and goal progress
The Coach is given no control to log food or edit the goal on the Client's behalf
